[system]: You opened the help panel from your "Web Platform Sprint — Automations" board. The "In Review" column contains correctly routed hotfix and normal cards, plus a few leftovers with missing or unexpected assignees from earlier rule experiments.
[end_user]: The assignment rules are finally sane, but now my manager wants a quick proof that In Review isn’t hiding any orphans and that hotfixes are clearly visible. I need a reusable view that lets me 1) see only In Review cards that *aren’t* on me or my reviewer, and 2) flip to a clear split of hotfix vs normal In Review work in standup. Spell out the exact clicks to set up whatever saved filter/view does that so I can pull it up in a couple of seconds.
rounds.reasoning_summary:
**Clarifying visibility requirements**

Okay, so the earlier request was to ensure that orphans and hotfixes are visible, especially since the manager wants to check the "In Review" column and see if any are being hidden. My first thoughts on filtering would be: "Column is In Review AND Assignee is not [you] AND Assignee is not [reviewer]." This would help show any orphans or those wrongly assigned. Including "Assignee is none" might be simple, but I want to keep it concise and exact.
**Creating split views for hotfixes**

For separating hotfixes from normal work, I think we can set up two quick filters or saved views. One would be "Column is In Review AND Label contains hotfix," and another could be "Column is In Review AND Label does not contain hotfix." The user mentioned wanting a clear split during standups, so I could also create a Board view filtered by "In Review" and grouped by Label or Tag. Many project boards support grouping, so I'll go with "Group by Label" within the filtered view, sticking to existing features.
**Outlining filter and view steps**

I need to make sure I describe how to use the UI clearly. First, the user should click "Filters" (that funnel icon) at the top right of the board header. From there, they can add a filter by setting criteria: Column -> is -> In Review; Assignee -> is not -> [Your name]; Assignee -> is not -> [Reviewer name]. They should save this as "In Review — Not Me/Reviewer." 

For splitting hotfixes from normal, they can open a saved view or create a new one with similar settings, using "Group by" label or tag and saving it as "In Review — Hotfix split."
**Providing filter options**

The user wants to switch between filters quickly, so two saved filters should do the trick. However, for a “clear split,” grouping might be better. I'll lay out both options clearly: First, to create a saved filter for orphaned or wrongly assigned tasks, open the Filters icon, set "Column is In Review," and select "Assignee is not" to pick your name and the reviewer’s name. Click "Save filter" and name it "In Review — Not Me/Reviewer."

Next, for a grouped view, click on Views in the board menu, create a view, and select either "List" or "Board.” For simplicity, use the "Group by" control on the board header, select "Label" to differentiate hotfixes from normal tasks, set the column again to "In Review," and save this view as "In Review — Hotfix Split."
**Drafting concise filter instructions**

To check for orphans, go to the board header, click the Filters icon (funnel), and set "Column" to "In Review." Click "+ Add filter," then set "Assignee" to "is not," select your name, and add another "Assignee is not" for the reviewer, which also includes unassigned tasks. Click "Save filter" and name it "In Review — Not Me/Reviewer."

For the hotfix split, click Views in the top left, create a new view, choose either "Board" or "List," and ensure the filter is "Column is In Review." Use "Group by" and select "Label," then save this view as "In Review — Hotfix Split." To toggle between views quickly, use the Views dropdown and select your saved view.
rounds.response:
1) Create the “not me/not reviewer” saved filter: click the funnel Filters icon in the board header → set Column = "In Review" → click "+ Add filter" → Assignee → choose "is not" → pick your name → click "+ Add filter" again → Assignee → "is not" → pick your reviewer → click "Save filter" (or "Save view") → name it "In Review — Not Me/Reviewer".  
2) Create the hotfix-split view for standup: click the Views dropdown (current view name) → Create view → choose "Board" (or "List") → in Filters set Column = "In Review" → in the view toolbar click "Group by" → choose "Label" (or "Tag") so hotfix and other labels appear as separate lanes → Save view as "In Review — Hotfix split".  
3) Switch between them quickly from the Views dropdown in the board header; for immediate side‑by‑side, open each saved view in its own browser tab.  
4) If your filter UI shows different control names, tell me the two labels you see under Filters and I’ll map the exact clicks to those names.

rounds.consequence: Your saved filter and grouped view instructions let the user quickly show their manager that no "In Review" work is unaccounted for and that hotfix items are clearly distinguished from normal items in standup, which improved the manager’s confidence in the new workflow.

[Messages]
[system]: You opened the help panel from your "Web Platform Sprint — Automations" board. You just used your saved views to prove in standup that the "In Review" column has no hidden orphans and that hotfix vs normal work is visible. Your manager now wants an easy way to see that same picture in regular status updates without another live demo.
[end_user]: The views you had me set up were good enough for today, but I don’t want to be doing a live tour of this board every week. I either need a link I can hand my manager that gives them a clean In Review view (orphans plus hotfix vs normal), or a quick export/report I can paste into our status email. Walk me through, step by step, the best way in this tool to 1) share a self-serve view if that’s possible, or 2) failing that, crank out a simple, repeatable snapshot I can reuse.
rounds.reasoning_summary:
**Creating a project view**

I’m thinking of creating a view that displays tasks in the "In Review" column, grouped by label, while filtering out tasks assigned to the user or the reviewer. This way, only orphan tasks will be visible. The steps include creating a view with specific filters and saving it under "In Review — Orphans & Hotfix split." I should share this view by accessing the menu in the Views dropdown. I’ll also consider implications for different products when sharing.
**Exporting a snapshot**

For exporting a view, I can guide on the steps: First, open the saved view and click the three-dot menu in the view toolbar or board header. Then select Export and choose either Export CSV or Print/Export to PDF. For exporting as CSV, confirm the action after selecting it. I can also attach the file directly to an email. If the user needs a combined view, I’m happy to help with that too!
**Creating and sharing a view**

To create a combined view, I’ll go to the Views dropdown and select "Create view," then choose Board or List. I’ll set the filters for "Column = In Review," and add filters excluding the user and reviewer. After grouping by Label, I’ll save it as "In Review — Orphans & Hotfix." To share the link, I will select the view from the dropdown and use the three-dot menu to copy the link. If sharing isn’t available, I can export it as a CSV or PDF to attach to an email.
**Offering guidance on view options**

I recommend using the share link for self-service or exporting a snapshot based on your preference. To create the view, go to the Views dropdown, select "Create view," and use the filters for "Column = In Review" and "Assignee is not [your name]" as well as "Assignee is not [reviewer name]." If you want to share the link, click the three-dot menu next to the view name and select "Share view" to copy the link. Alternatively, for exporting, click the three-dot menu and choose "Export" and then "Export CSV" or "Print." Just let me know what you prefer, and I’ll provide the exact clicks!
rounds.response:
1) Make one reusable view that shows orphans and splits hotfixes: Views dropdown → Create view → choose "Board" (or "List") → Filters: Column = "In Review" → + Add filter → Assignee → "is not" → select your name → + Add filter → Assignee → "is not" → select reviewer → in the view toolbar click "Group by" → choose "Label" → Save view as "In Review — Orphans & Hotfix".  
2) To give your manager a self‑serve link: open the saved view → click the view's three‑dot menu (•••) next to the view name → "Share view" (or "Copy view link"/toggle "Make view shareable") → Copy link and send it.  
3) If sharing is disabled in your build or you prefer a static snapshot: open that view → click the board three‑dot menu (or the view three‑dot) → Export → "Export CSV" (or choose "Print" → "Save as PDF") → attach the file to your status email.  
4) Tell me which option you want and I’ll walk the exact clicks for the UI labels you see if any of those menu names differ.
